prompt: A precision UI icon atlas continuing an established minimal Obsidian-style monoline toolbar icon family. Landscape canvas exactly three equal square cells in ONE horizontal row, pure white background. Each cell contains one large centered black outline icon, same apparent size, consistent 24-pixel stroke on a 512-pixel cell, rounded line caps and rounded joins, flat high contrast, absolutely no texture, gray, shadows, gradients, text, letters, labels, borders or decorations. Keep generous completely blank margins and cells separate. LEFT: a simple outline file folder with a short top-left tab, and a small plus sign centered inside the folder body, for New Folder. MIDDLE: sort ascending by file name, represented ONLY by a vertical upward-pointing arrow on the left and three horizontal lines on the right, the top shortest and bottom longest, no letters or numbers. RIGHT: Collapse All, represented by two clean separated chevrons facing inward vertically: the upper chevron points down and the lower chevron points up, centered on the same axis. The silhouette of each icon must remain crisp and recognizable at 18 and 24 pixels. Exact clean geometric alignment, no doubled strokes or stray marks. Do not put the icon names in the image.
selectedRationale: Continues the selected monoline toolbar direction. Folder, ascending sort and inward chevrons are distinct, high contrast and visually clean.
